## Category 1: Database Schema (3 tests)

### UAT-1.1: is_private column exists on clarity_sessions
**Given:** Migration `20260217_p393_is_private_session.sql` applied
**Then:** `clarity_sessions` table has `is_private BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false` column
**Verify:** Supabase dashboard — inspect `clarity_sessions` table structure; confirm column type and default

### UAT-1.2: Existing sessions unaffected (default false)
**Given:** Sessions created before the migration
**Then:** All existing rows have `is_private = false` (default applies retroactively)
**Verify:** Supabase dashboard — `SELECT id, is_private FROM clarity_sessions LIMIT 10;` — all rows show `false`

### UAT-1.3: RLS UPDATE policy restricts is_private to creator only
**Given:** A session with `creator_profile_id = user_A`
**When:** User B (authenticated, not the creator) attempts to UPDATE `is_private` on that session
**Then:** Update is rejected (RLS WITH CHECK fails)
**Verify:** Supabase dashboard — attempt update as different user; confirm 403/permission denied

## Category 2: Recording Toggle — Start View (5 tests)

### UAT-2.1: Recording toggle is visible in Start view
**Given:** User navigates to `/live`
**When:** Page loads
**Then:** Recording toggle row is visible between the name/email inputs and the "New session" button
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — screenshot Start view; toggle row visible

### UAT-2.2: Toggle defaults to ON (recording enabled)
**Given:** User navigates to `/live` (fresh load, no prior state)
**When:** Page loads
**Then:** Toggle is in ON position; `aria-checked="true"`; label reads "Record for AI Insights" (or similar)
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — check `aria-checked` attribute; confirm ON state visually

### UAT-2.3: Toggle OFF changes consent label
**Given:** User is on Start view, toggle is ON
**When:** User clicks the toggle to turn it OFF
**Then:** Consent checkbox label changes to "I accept the Terms & Privacy Policy" (recording sentence removed)
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — click toggle; confirm label text change; confirm checkbox cleared

### UAT-2.4: Toggle change clears consent checkbox
**Given:** User checked the consent checkbox
**When:** User clicks the toggle (either direction)
**Then:** Consent checkbox is unchecked; user must re-check it before proceeding
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — check box, toggle, confirm box is unchecked

### UAT-2.5: Toggle is locked after session creation (Waiting Room)
**Given:** Creator turned toggle OFF and clicked "New session" (session created)
**When:** Creator is in the Waiting Room
**Then:** No interactive toggle is visible; only a read-only status badge is shown
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — reach Waiting Room as logged-in creator; confirm no interactive toggle element

## Category 3: Waiting Room — Recording Status Badge (2 tests)

### UAT-3.1: Private session badge shows in Waiting Room when recording is OFF
**Given:** Creator turned recording OFF before creating the session
**When:** Creator reaches the Waiting Room
**Then:** A gray badge with shield icon and "Private session — Not recorded" text is shown below the share link row
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — screenshot Waiting Room; confirm gray badge visible, blue recording badge absent

### UAT-3.2: Recording badge shows in Waiting Room when recording is ON (default)
**Given:** Creator kept toggle ON (default) and created the session
**When:** Creator reaches the Waiting Room
**Then:** A blue badge with "Recording enabled for AI Insights" text is shown
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — screenshot Waiting Room; confirm blue badge visible

## Category 4: Join Screen — Session Status Badge (3 tests)

### UAT-4.1: Private session badge shown to joiner on join screen
**Given:** Session was created with `is_private = true`
**When:** Joiner opens the share link `/live/{code}`
**Then:** Gray badge "Private session — Not recorded" appears below the join heading, above the name input
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — open join URL for private session; screenshot badge area

### UAT-4.2: Recorded session badge shown to joiner on join screen
**Given:** Session was created with `is_private = false` (default)
**When:** Joiner opens the share link `/live/{code}`
**Then:** Blue badge "This session will be recorded for AI Insights" appears
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — open join URL for recorded session; screenshot badge area

### UAT-4.3: Badge skeleton shows while loading, omitted on error
**Given:** Join URL opened, session data loading
**When:** API call is in-flight
**Then:** Skeleton placeholder (same dimensions, `animate-pulse`) is shown while loading
**When:** API call fails or times out (>3s)
**Then:** Badge is omitted; join form still functional (fail silently)
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — simulate slow/failed network; confirm form not blocked

### UAT-5.1: Private session band shown in Live view
**Given:** Session was created with `is_private = true`
**When:** Both creator and joiner enter the Live view
**Then:** Gray band "Private session" (with shield icon) is shown below the nav bar; existing blue recording banner is NOT shown
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — reach Live view with private session; screenshot band area

**Given:** Session was created with `is_private = false` (default)
**When:** Both creator and joiner enter the Live view
**Then:** Existing blue "Session recorded for AI Insights" band is shown (unchanged from today)
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — reach Live view with recorded session; screenshot band area

## Category 6: Privacy Guarantee — No Data Capture (4 tests)

### UAT-6.1: No microphone permission dialog for private session
**Given:** User creates a private session (recording OFF)
**When:** Creator reaches the Waiting Room and transitions to Live view
**Then:** Browser does NOT show a microphone permission dialog at any point
**Verify:** Manual — observe browser permission bar; confirm no mic request appears

### UAT-6.2: No audio captured in private session
**Given:** Private session is active (both users in Live view)
**When:** Both users speak during the session
**Then:** No audio chunks are uploaded to GCS; `ml_training_sessions` table has no new rows for this session
**Verify:** Supabase dashboard — query `ml_training_sessions WHERE session_id = '<private_session_id>'`; expect 0 rows. GCS bucket — confirm no new files for this session code.

### UAT-6.3: Session history still saved for private session
**Given:** A private session is completed (both users exit Live view)
**Then:** The session row exists in `clarity_sessions` with `is_private = true` and `status = 'completed'`
**Then:** Session appears in the creator's session history (dashboard or profile)
**Verify:** Supabase dashboard — query `clarity_sessions WHERE is_private = true`; confirm row exists with correct status

### UAT-6.4: All clarity check mechanics work in private mode
**Given:** Private session is active
**When:** Creator submits a rating; joiner submits an explain-back; both view results
**Then:** Rating, explain-back, and scoring all work identically to a recorded session
**Verify:** Complete full clarity check flow in private mode; confirm results page shows correctly

## Category 7: Guest User — Consent in Private Mode (2 tests)

### UAT-7.1: Consent checkbox required in private mode (guest user)
**Given:** Guest user on Start view, toggle turned OFF
**When:** Guest fills in name and email but does NOT check the consent checkbox
**Then:** "New session" button remains disabled; guest cannot proceed
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — fill name/email, leave box unchecked, confirm button disabled

### UAT-7.2: Private mode consent label for joiner (guest)
**Given:** Private session exists; guest joiner opens join link
**When:** Join form loads with session badge showing private state
**Then:** Consent checkbox label shows "I accept the Terms & Privacy Policy" (no recording sentence)
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — screenshot join form for private session; confirm label text

**Then:** Creator returns to Start view with toggle reset to ON (default)
**Verify:** Playwright MCP — reach Waiting Room, click Cancel; confirm toggle `aria-checked="true"` on return

- **Two-browser context needed** — UAT-4.x, 5.x need creator + joiner; use Playwright `browser.newContext()`

- **Security fix prerequisite** — UAT-6.2 fully guaranteed only after Cloud Function `gcs-signed-url` is updated to check `is_private`
